disputes.call: Treat it as missable. Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony right after Down to Earth, and keep a Chapter 1 save before the chapter ends — the safe play costs nothing if the other side is right.
disputes.question: Is Positive Mental Attitude missable?
disputes.sideA: PowerPyx flags it as the one possibly missable trophy: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation may not return later. [2] [3]
disputes.sideB: Push Square reports no missable trophies known. [11]

disputes.call: Track 18 in this guide. The counter runs to 18; the last three spots are the safety margin if a shorter list is right.
disputes.question: Meditation total — 15 or 18 spots?
disputes.sideA: The trophy counts 18 meditation spots across Leonida. [2] [3]

disputes.call: Follow the in-game 100% checklist. Stage 7 of this roadmap mirrors it, so nothing the game counts is left to the end by accident.
disputes.question: Does 100% need every activity?
disputes.sideA: The 100% checklist covers story, strangers, collectibles and activities. [4]
disputes.sideB: Some guides count only what the in-game checklist shows. [6] [9]

stages.blurb: Play the opening, meet Lucia and Jason, learn the map — and bank the one trophy that might not come back.
stages.title: Chapters 1–2 · Learn Leonida

stages.blurb: Vice City opens up: more missions, more systems, first stranger strands.
stages.title: Chapters 3–4 · Vice City opens up

stages.blurb: Finish the story, close every stranger strand, and keep the partner trophies in mind.
stages.title: Finale & stranger strands

stages.blurb: Races, shooting ranges, stunts and every activity type once — the skill grind.
stages.title: Activities & skills

stages.blurb: Shops, vaults, trucks and gang operations — loud, fast, and wanted.
stages.title: Robbery & the wanted game

stages.blurb: Slow down: explore all 52 areas, find the collectibles, soak in the odd moments.
stages.title: Exploration & collectibles

stages.blurb: Launder, spend, buy garages, register rides — then the last push to 100%.
stages.title: Money, garages & 100%

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: There is no trick to it: this trophy is the receipt for the other 54. Work the roadmap in order and it arrives last.
Check the progress card at the top of this guide — when it reads 54/55, one trophy is left, and it is named in the Next Up list.
It is the only platinum in the list, so no separate grind exists for it.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing — the first story trophy.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is unmissable in the story flow — just finish it.
Use the mission to learn the basics: driving, the wanted system and switching between Lucia and Jason.
At risk only in the sense that it belongs to the opening mission window — finish the mission and it is banked for good.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 mission.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1 to its last mission. The trophy pops at the chapter card.
Before the chapter ends, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — see its guide.
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a save is your only rewind.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2 to its last mission. The trophy pops at the chapter card.
Chapter 2 opens more of the map — grab the exploration and activity trophies that unlock here while you pass them.
Stranger strands start appearing across Leonida now; starting one early spreads the grind.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 3 mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3 to its last mission. The trophy pops at the chapter card.
Vice City proper opens up here — most activities, shops and races become available.
If a stranger strand is available in the city, take it now rather than backtracking later.

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 4 mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4 to its last mission. The trophy pops at the chapter card.
Late-story missions pay the most, so this is a good chapter to fund the money trophies.
Before the finale, check the Missables tab — anything flagged there should be done before the story ends.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — the story's gold trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Play the final mission to the end. It is a gold trophy, the story's biggest single prize.
Finish any chapter-gated side content first — after the finale, the world stays open, but story windows close.
Difficulty is a free choice: the trophy asks only that the mission is completed.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Play the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in Chapter 1 or 2.
It is a partner mission — keep your partner close and follow the mission markers rather than free-roaming mid-mission.
At risk only because it belongs to one mission window: finish the mission and the trophy is banked.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Play the mission The Cartel Heist when the story offers it.
Heist missions reward planning: stock up on armour and ammo before the approach, not during it.
The heist is also good practice for the robbery trophies in Stage 5 — same systems, smaller stakes.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Play the mission Child's Play when the story offers it.
Family missions mix driving and on-foot sections — keep a fast car nearby for the getaway part.
No special loadout is needed; the mission is tuned for whatever you are carrying.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Play the mission Headliners when the story offers it.
Headliners leans on stealth and timing — watch the patrols before moving, and restart the checkpoint if spotted early.
The trophy is for completion only, so a messy finish still counts.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Play the mission VCIA Takedown when the story offers it.
The airport setting means open ground and long sightlines — use cover and Combat Focus rather than sprinting across the tarmac.
This mission pairs well with the Gunslinger practice in Stage 4: one Combat Focus can drop several enemies here.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory when the story offers it.
It is one of the heavier combat missions — bring full armour, a rifle with range, and snacks or healing if the game offers them.
Checkpoints are generous; if a section wipes you, replay from the checkpoint instead of restarting the mission.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the second gold trophy and the real endgame.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Open the in-game 100% checklist (Progress > Collections > 100% in the pause menu, per PowerPyx) and work it line by line.
The checklist covers story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration — Stage 7 of this roadmap mirrors it.
Save the grindy counts for last: 250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK spots and the card sets.
This trophy and the platinum arrive together at the end — when one pops, the other follows.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and drifts all count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: A stunt is any jump, near miss, drift or airtime the game flashes on screen. Normal driving racks them up slowly.
Farm them deliberately: find a ramp or jump, hit it at speed, land clean, and repeat — the counter in this guide tracks your 250.
Mix stunt types. The game credits variety, and repeating one jump gets slower as the counter climbs.
Use the counter below: tick up after each session so you always know how many are left.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — the sampler trophy.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Open the Activities list in the pause menu — it shows every activity type in the game.
Play one of each: a race, a shooting range challenge, fishing, bowling, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest.
You only need to TRY each type, not win it — starting and finishing one round is enough.
Tick each type off in this guide as you try it; the counter runs to 9.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the aim trainer's silver.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: The Shooting Range lists 42 challenges across its weapon courses. Each one grades bronze, silver or gold on score.
Learn one course at a time: walk it first to see the target order, then run it for score.
Gold needs accuracy over speed — slow, aimed shots beat spraying, and headshots pay best.
Track golds in the counter below. The last few courses are the hardest, so leave time for retries.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Top Fun drone races are marked on the map once unlocked. There are 14 locations in total.
Each race is a checkpoint course against the clock and rival drones — learn the gates on a practice run first.
Cut corners between gates where the course allows it, and brake before tight turns instead of bouncing off walls.
Tick each location off below as you win it; the counter runs to 14.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — road, off-road and water count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Races are scattered across Leonida: street races, off-road and boat races all count toward the 20.
Different means different events — winning the same race twice only counts once.
Pick a fast, stable car for road races and a boat with good handling for water races; upgrade before the harder events.
Use the counter below to log each new win so repeats never fool you.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a friendly rivalry with a window.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Take the fishing challenge against Cal when it appears early in the story.
Fishing is a timing mini-game: wait for the bite, then reel with steady tension and ease off when the line strains.
At risk because the challenge belongs to an early story window — do it when Cal offers it, not chapters later.

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Walk into any arcade in Vice City and start a game.
Pick the shortest game on your first visit — the trophy asks for a completion, not a high score.
Arcade games also count toward the activity types for Master of None, so this visit does double duty.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand — his last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Meet Andy when his strand marker appears, then play his missions in order.
Stranger strands unlock across chapters — if Andy's next mission is not offered yet, push the story forward.
The final mission is the payoff: finish it and the strand closes with the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand — his last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Meet Kenton when his strand marker appears, then play his missions in order.
Kenton's strand leans on boats and the water — keep a fast boat handy near the coast.
Finish the strand before the finale; stranger strands can close when the story moves past them.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand — his last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Meet Billy when his strand marker appears, then play his missions in order.
Billy's strand is bike-heavy — a fast motorcycle makes every mission smoother.
The last mission is the trophy: finish it and the strand closes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands — the silver for meeting Leonida's oddballs.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Stranger strands are the side missions marked across Leonida. There are more than 8 — you need any 8 done.
Start strands as they appear instead of saving them all for the end: some only open in certain chapters.
Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each close a strand of their own — five of your eight.
Track finished strands in the counter below; the trophy pops at the eighth.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand — his last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Meet Randy when his strand marker appears, then play his missions in order.
Randy's strand is about supply runs — expect timed deliveries and rival crews on the road.
Finish the strand before the finale so its missions stay open.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand — his last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Meet Tyrone when his strand marker appears, then play his missions in order.
Tyrone's strand mixes driving and combat — bring a car you can lose and a weapon you trust.
The last mission closes the strand and banks the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots — the only possibly missable trophy. Do the Chapter 1 balcony first.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: MISSABLE WINDOW: the morning after the Down to Earth mission (Chapter 1), talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. [2] [3]
The balcony session adds +1 to the counter even though it is not a marked spot — that is why some lists miss it. [3] [5]
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save before the chapter ends. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, and the balcony may not return. [2] [3]
After Chapter 1, work the other spots: Smooth Sand on the west Capri sandbar, Buckskin Swamp dock, Emerald River, Manifest Canyon red rocks. [3] [5]
North and coast spots include the Moreau ruined mill wheel, the Jutting Cliff tower above the mountains, and the Ascent Mountain peak at Mount Kalaga. [3] [5]
Track every spot in the counter below — it runs to 18, and the trophy pops at the last one. [2] [3]

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Meet Bret and take the hunt when his strand offers it.
The animal is unique — one specific creature in one specific area. Follow Bret's directions and the map marker.
Hunt cleanly: a scoped rifle and patience beat chasing it through the brush.
Bring the kill back to Bret to close the strand and bank the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — the set-builder's silver.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Collectible cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and odd corners. Each set needs every card in it.
Work one set at a time so the collection screen stays readable, and tick each card off in this guide.
Cards cluster by area: clear one neighbourhood fully before moving on, or you will backtrack for one missing card.
The trophy pops at the third completed set — the counter below tracks sets, not single cards.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the photo-mode marathon.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: WAiNK It is the in-game photo mode: frame a landmark, a view or a moment and take the shot.
100 different locations count — the same spot twice only counts once, so keep moving.
Fold it into exploration: every time you reach a new area for The Goodtime State, take a WAiNK shot there too.
Use the counter below after each session. The last 20 locations are the grind — save a list of unvisited viewpoints.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges — the checklist inside the checklist.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Challenges are the small feats listed in the pause menu: driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats and more.
Many complete themselves during normal play — check the list after each story chapter to see what is close.
Target the easy ones first (short drives, simple stunts), then the long ones (stunt totals, race wins) while doing other trophies.
The counter below runs to 50; the trophy pops the moment the fiftieth challenge ticks over.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level together with your partner — then vanish.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you — cause chaos in a busy area until the fourth star appears.
Then break line of sight: lose the cops in alleys, tunnels or the countryside until the stars blink and clear.
A fast car with good handling helps more than a fast car with top speed — you need corners, not straights.
Your partner must be with you when the heat clears. If they are left behind, the trophy will not pop.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner — and keep the wanted level the whole time.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Pick three shops close together on the map before you start — distance is the enemy here.
Rob the first, get back in the car with your partner, and hit the next one without letting the wanted level drop.
Do not kill the shopkeepers if you can avoid it: a quick robbery keeps the heat low enough to survive three in a row.
The third till is the trophy. If the stars clear between shops, the chain resets — start over.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive everything, even once.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you drive it — cars, bikes, boats, planes and oddities.
Variety beats mileage: a new model in a car park counts, the same sedan for an hour does not.
Raid car parks, dealerships and docks. Rare spawns hide in specific neighbourhoods at specific times.
Use the counter below and the Scooter Bros app: registering rides for On the Spot counts discoveries too.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus — slow-mo, five targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Combat Focus slows time and lets you mark targets. You need five takedowns before it ends.
Pick a busy fight: a gang shootout or a mission with clustered enemies, not a lone straggler.
Soften the group first with a grenade or a car, then trigger Focus and finish the five while they are weak.
The VCIA Takedown mission is a good stage — open ground, grouped enemies, and checkpoints if it fails.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way — steal a plane, skip the queue.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Get into Vice City International Airport and find a plane on the tarmac.
Take off without a flight plan — the trophy is about the unscheduled departure, not the destination.
Expect heat: the airport is guarded, so go in fast, grab the plane and climb before the response arrives.
Any runway works. Land anywhere safe afterwards — the trophy pops on departure.

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Hot work.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Rhinos are the army's tanks — they appear at high wanted levels and around military areas.
Do not fight one head-on in a car. Use sticky bombs, heavy weapons or a high vantage point.
Lure it into a narrow street where its cannon cannot track you, then hit the rear armour.
The trophy is for dealing with the Rhinos — survive the encounter and it is yours.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store unseen — ghost the whole job.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and case it first: cameras, guards, exits.
Go at night, move quietly, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted.
If a guard turns, restart from the checkpoint — detection fails the trophy even if you escape.
A clean exit is part of it: leave the area before the response arrives.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — the vault-cracker's silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the take.
Each vault needs its own prep — check the job board or contacts for vault jobs as they appear.
Escape is half the trophy: have a getaway car parked close and a route out of the neighbourhood.
The counter below runs to 5. A failed escape does not count the vault — only clean getaways do.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Armored trucks run set routes through the city — watch for one, then stop it.
Block the road ahead of the truck, force it to stop, and crack the rear doors.
Grab the cash fast: the truck's guards and the police response both arrive quickly.
Escape clean and the trophy pops — a getaway without losing the take.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every corner of the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Leonida is divided into 52 named areas. An area counts once you have driven through its heart.
Work the map region by region: Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the mountains and the farmland.
The map shades explored areas — sweep for the last unshaded pockets at the edges.
Fold in WAiNK shots as you go: every new area is also a photo location for You WAiNKer!.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Each gang runs illegal operations — stills, labs, stash houses — marked through contacts and exploration.
Hit one operation per gang. There are 9 gangs, so 9 hits in total.
Expect the gang to fight back: each operation is guarded, and the owners do not like visitors.
Tick each gang off below as its operation falls; the trophy pops at the ninth.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — slow down, Leonida.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a sea view, and order a cocktail.
Sit, watch the ocean, and let the scene play — the trophy is a breather, not a grind.
Do it early in Stage 1: it is a five-minute trophy that sets the tone for the whole guide.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Drive into a vehicle showroom, pick your car, and leave through the glass — in classic style.
Speed matters more than the car: hit the window at full tilt and keep driving.
Expect a wanted level on exit — have your escape route planned before you smash in.
One clean smash-through is all it takes.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
Play a full game: aim, set the power, and follow through on the release.
Bowling is a timing game — a smooth release beats a hard throw.
Finish the game and the trophy pops. Bowling also counts toward the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — Lucia and Jason, together.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: This one pops from a partnership moment in the story — play the missions with your partner.
Keep switching between Lucia and Jason and doing activities together; the moment arrives on its own.
If it has not popped by the finale, check the Missables tab — it may be tied to a scene you rushed past.

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices — every decision in Leonida counts.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: The game tracks choices: dialogue picks, mission approaches, who you help and who you cross.
500 is a long count, so do not chase it — play naturally and check the counter now and then.
Side content is dense with choices: stranger strands, activities and random encounters all add up.
Use the counter below as a rough gauge. It moves slowly, then suddenly — that is normal.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail once, nail it next.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Fail something, then succeed at the same thing on your next try.
The easiest path is a race or a challenge: miss the win once, then win the rematch.
Do not force it early — it pops naturally during the activity grind in Stage 4.
If it has not popped by Stage 6, replay any race you lost and win it second time around.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida's weird side.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Something strange is out there in Leonida — a random encounter, a odd scene, a thing that should not be.
Explore off the beaten path: the swamps, the desert roads and the coastline at night.
Talk to strangers and follow odd markers. The strange things hide where the map looks empty.
When it happens, you will know — the trophy pops the moment you witness it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: Get in a car, pick up speed, and swing a melee weapon out of the window at a pedestrian.
Timing is everything: swing just as you draw level, not before.
A slow cruise through a busy street beats a highway blast — you need a target in reach.
One clean knockdown is the trophy. Expect a wanted level right after.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — dirty money you cannot spend directly.
Take the bills to your contacts, who launder them for a cut. Each handover adds to the $250,000.
Robberies in Stage 5 are the fastest source of marked bills — launder after every big job.
The counter below tracks dollars laundered. It is a long grind, so start early and launder often.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cars, clothes, weapons, everything.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Every dollar spent in any shop counts: cars, clothes, weapons, ammo, food.
Big purchases do the heavy lifting — a car or a property chunk counts thousands at once.
Do not save it for last: buy what you need as you play and the total climbs on its own.
Check the counter below after shopping trips. At $100,000 the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties — every garage in Leonida.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Garage properties are for sale across Leonida — 8 in total.
Each one costs money and stores vehicles, so buy them as your funds allow during the story.
Garages cluster in the cities and the countryside alike — check the property listings on the in-game web.
Tick each garage off below as you buy it. The eighth purchase is the trophy.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone and register a vehicle you own or drive.
Any vehicle counts — cars, bikes, boats. Drive it, open the app, register it.
Fold it into Whip It Good: every new discovery is also a registration candidate.
The counter below runs to 10. Ten registrations and the trophy pops.
